blocks.value: Profit is the money left after a company pays all of its expenses, including salaries, rent, taxes, interest and operating costs.
Imagine This: Your café earns ₹1 lakh in a month, but you spend ₹80,000 on rent, salaries and ingredients. The remaining ₹20,000 is your profit.
A company with growing revenue but falling profits may be spending too much or facing business challenges.
Revenue ₹500 crore - Expenses ₹420 crore = Profit ₹80 crore.
Revenue shows how much a company earns. Profit shows how much it actually keeps.
